headline: Midterm Election Results Spark Debate Over AI Data Centers and Energy Stocks
summary: US midterm election results are reshaping the map for AI data centers, potentially causing project delays and increased expenses while analysts debate an 'excessive knee-jerk' reaction in energy stocks like Vistra.
why: Shifts in political control can alter regulatory pathways and infrastructure spending, directly affecting utility providers and data center developers.

impacts.name: Utilities
impacts.why: Political changes and regulatory scrutiny regarding data center power demand create valuation pressure on power and energy stocks.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Concerns over potential regulatory changes and policy shifts following the midterms prompted a sell-off in energy and power generation equities.
